{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping the row with the highest sample_seq
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Filter to treatment arm only
treatment_only = df_dedup[df_dedup['arm'] == 'treatment']

# Compute the fraction of responders
fraction_responded = treatment_only['responded'].mean()

# Print result
print(fraction_responded)"}
